title: AI in the energy sector: adoption, workforce skills and overseas use cases
asked: Ms Valerie Lee asked what the Government is doing to increase AI adoption in energy generation, and how it is helping businesses and households use AI to save energy.
response: EMA launched a regulatory sandbox for Virtual Power Plants in 2025, where pilots may use AI to forecast renewable generation output and optimise generation capacity; EMA also uses AI in its internal energy management systems for solar forecasting. Enterprise Singapore supports the Singapore Business Federation's Cost and Carbon Reduction Programme, which uses a proprietary AI tool to help SMEs find cost reduction and decarbonisation opportunities. On skills, there is a Skills Framework for Energy and Power, and for niche skills the Government will work with industry and educational institutions to update curricula. On overseas practice, the Government is studying AI solutions other countries have deployed for energy generation and the grid network.

key_points.point: EMA launched a regulatory sandbox for Virtual Power Plants in 2025
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: In 2025, the Energy Market Authority (EMA) launched a regulatory sandbox for Virtual Power Plants (VPPs)

key_points.point: VPP pilots may use AI to forecast renewable output and optimise generation capacity against wholesale market conditions
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: VPP pilots may utilise AI to forecast renewable generation output and optimise generation capacity based on prevailing wholesale market conditions.

key_points.point: EMA uses AI in its internal energy management systems for solar forecasting
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: EMA has also incorporated AI within its internal energy management systems to support solar forecasting.

key_points.point: Enterprise Singapore supports the Singapore Business Federation's Cost and Carbon Reduction Programme
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: Enterprise Singapore supports the Singapore Business Federation's Cost and Carbon Reduction Programme.

key_points.point: That programme uses a proprietary AI tool to help SMEs identify cost reduction and decarbonisation opportunities
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: The programme utilises a proprietary AI tool to help small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) identify cost reduction and decarbonisation opportunities

key_points.point: A Skills Framework for Energy and Power was developed by SkillsFuture Singapore, Workforce Singapore and EMA with industry and union partners
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: we have the Skills Framework for Energy and Power developed by SkillsFuture Singapore, Workforce Singapore and EMA with industry and union partners

key_points.point: For niche skills, the Government will work with industry partners and educational institutions to update curricula and grow talent
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: For niche skills, the Government will work closely with industry partners and educational institutions to update the curriculum and grow talent to meet the sector's needs.

key_points.point: The Government is studying AI solutions other countries have deployed for energy generation and the grid network
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: We are studying various AI solutions, which other countries have deployed for both energy generation and the grid network.

key_points.point: Examples studied include AI for predictive maintenance of energy assets and machine learning for operational efficiency of traditional and renewable sources
key_points.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
key_points.quote: Some examples include the use of AI for predictive maintenance of energy assets and the application of machine learning to enhance the operational efficiency of both traditional and renewable energy sources.

left_open: Which specific countries were studied for AI use in the power sector
supplementary: Workforce skills for AI in energy, and overseas use cases for AI in power dispatch and generation efficiency.
